# Badge

Tiny uppercase confidence flag shown inline after a fill-rate figure in proposals.

`InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.Badge` · Core

## Use

```jsx

```


## Notes

Feasibility confidence flag used next to fill rates in proposals ("100% fill (4 of 4) HIGH CONFIDENCE").
